title: 第26章 暗劲第27章 宝鱼
content_zh:
“在下陆沉。”
陆沉走了出来，平静的来到院中。
那青竹帮主瞳孔微缩，连忙笑着拱手道：“原来是陆兄弟，在下青竹帮主‘赵刚’，久仰陆兄弟大名了。”
“不知陆兄弟来此，所为何事？”
陆沉平静抬眸道：“陆某废了这李莽，这裂石帮钱粮，陆某怎么也得分一杯羹吧？”
青竹帮众人闻言，顿时露出一丝冷意，显然不想分这一杯羹。
不过陆沉冷笑一声，然后开口说道：“怎么，你们不卖我这个面子，难道也不卖我沈院的面子？”
青竹帮众闻言，顿时露出一丝忌惮。
武馆的入室弟子，身份跟学徒完全不一样了，那些学徒不准打着武馆名号做事。
但是这些入室弟子算是沈院自己人，他们若是敢动的话，哪怕沈衡不亲自出手，那些师兄弟也能把他们料理了。
明白这一点，青竹帮主连忙笑道：“自然有陆兄弟一份，只是我们上百个兄弟忙活一阵，总该占个大头的。”
陆沉这才点头道：“我要裂石拳的全本，此外缴获银两我要三成。”
青竹帮主闻言，顿时松了一口气。
三成银两他还能接受，至于裂石拳的全本那更是不算什么。
一本不入流的功法，市价最多几十两银子，还不值得他们跟陆沉翻脸。
于是一番商议后，青竹帮分了陆沉三百两白银，外加一本裂石拳的全本功法。
……
“玄者，自然之始祖，而万殊之大宗也。”
小寒书院，陆沉捧着一卷古籍，坐在窗户之旁，看得有些入迷。
直到天色渐晚，陆沉才合起这卷抱朴子，将其放回书架上：“两个月时间，读书已有一千三百多卷了。”

自从解决裂石帮这个隐患后，陆沉就把心思放在修炼上。
这两个月里，他每日抽出八个时辰练拳，有了充足的宝肉和气血丹，铁甲功、烈火功、裂石拳、惊雷步、六合腿都进展迅速。
此外，为了点亮‘智慧星辰’，他还在这小寒书院报了名，每日抽出三个时辰来此读书。
放好书卷，陆沉起身离开，临别前看着书院外的中年男子，当即躬身行礼道：“见过山主。”
“有礼了。”
小寒山主点头，微笑说道：“今日看得如何？”
“观书二十一卷，略有感悟。”陆沉客气的道。
小寒书院的山主名为‘李长歌’，是一个手无缚鸡之力的文人，但是文学造诣却学究天人，琴棋书画样样精通，颇具才名。
“可惜这是武道世界，否则此人必定名留青史。”陆沉心中有些惋惜。
那李长歌颔了颔首，然后开口说道：“习武之人，能沉下心读书的不多了，你算是难得之人，以后的束脩就免了吧。”
陆沉愣了一下，当即客气的道：“那多谢山主了。”
李长歌没有再说，只是摆了摆手让他离去。
一路回到家，陆沉将借来的书收起，然后就开始修炼武学。
在两个月的修炼之中，陆沉的武学进展极快，烈火功、裂石拳、六合腿、铁砂掌这四门不入流武学，都已经修至大成极限，距离圆满层次只剩一步之遥。
至于两门三流武学，铁甲功和惊雷步也已经进展很快，距离大成只剩下最后一步之遥了。
content_en:
"Sinking in the lower land."
Lu Chen walked out and came to the courtyard calmly.
The Qingzhu Gang leader's pupils shrank, he quickly smiled and cupped his hands and said: "It turns out to be Brother Lu. I am the Qingzhu Gang leader 'Zhao Gang'. I have admired Brother Lu's name for a long time."
"I wonder why Brother Lu came here?"
Lu Chen calmly raised his eyes and said, "Lu has crippled Li Mang, and the Split Stone Gang has given him money and food. How can Lu get a piece of the pie?"
When everyone in the Qingzhu Gang heard this, they suddenly showed a hint of coldness, obviously not wanting to take a share of the pie.
But Lu Chen sneered, and then said: "Why, if you don't sell me my face, don't you sell my Shen Yuan's face too?"
When the Qingzhu Gang heard this, they suddenly showed a hint of fear.
The status of the disciples who enter the martial arts hall is completely different from that of the apprentices. Those apprentices are not allowed to do things in the name of the martial arts gym.
But these disciples who broke into the house were regarded as Shen Yuan's own people. If they dared to make a move, even if Shen Heng didn't take action himself, the brothers would be able to take care of them.
Understanding this, the leader of the Qingzhu Gang quickly smiled and said: "Brother Lu will naturally have a share, but we have hundreds of brothers who have been busy for a while, so they should take up a big share."
Lu Chen then nodded and said, "I want the complete copy of Stone Splitting Fist, and in addition I want 30% of the silver captured."
Upon hearing this, the leader of the Qingzhu Gang breathed a sigh of relief.
He could still accept 30% silver, but the complete copy of Stone Splitting Fist was nothing.
The market price of a low-grade Kung Fu method was only a few dozen taels of silver at most, and it was not worth it for them to fall out with Lu Chen.
So after some discussion, the Qingzhu Gang gave Lu Chen three hundred taels of silver, plus a complete copy of the Stone Splitting Fist.
…
"Xuanzhe is the ancestor of nature and the great sect of all things."
In Xiaohan Academy, Lu Chen held a volume of ancient books and sat by the window, looking fascinated.
It wasn't until it was getting late that Lu Chen closed the volume of Baopuzi and put it back on the bookshelf: "In two months, I have read more than 1,300 volumes."
Since solving the hidden danger of the Split Stone Gang, Lu Chen has focused on cultivation.
In the past two months, he devoted eight hours a day to practicing boxing. With enough precious meat and qi and blood pills, he made rapid progress in Iron Armor Kung Fu, Fiery Fire Kung Fu, Stone Splitting Fist, Thunder Step, and Liuhe Kick.
In addition, in order to light up the 'Star of Wisdom', he also signed up for Xiaohan Academy and dedicated three hours a day to study here.
After putting down the scroll, Lu Chen stood up and left. Before leaving, he looked at the middle-aged man outside the academy and immediately bowed and said, "I have met the mountain master."
"It's polite."
Lord Xiaohan nodded and said with a smile, "How was your viewing today?"
"After reading the twenty-one volumes, I have some insights." Lu Chen said politely.
The mountain master of Xiaohan Academy is named "Li Changge". He is a scholar who has no power to tie a chicken, but he is very knowledgeable in literary attainments. He is proficient in all kinds of music, chess, calligraphy and painting, and is quite talented.
"It's a pity that this is the world of martial arts, otherwise this person will definitely leave his name in history." Lu Chen felt a little regretful in his heart.
Li Changge nodded, and then said: "There are not many people who practice martial arts who can calm down and study. You are a rare person. You will be exempted from the need to practice in the future."
Lu Chen was stunned for a moment, then said politely: "Thank you very much, Lord Mountain."
Li Changge said nothing more, just waved his hand and asked him to leave.
All the way home, Lu Chen put away the borrowed books and began to practice martial arts.
During the two months of training, Lu Chen's martial arts progressed very quickly. Four unfavorable martial arts, including Fiery Fire Kung Fu, Rock Splitting Fist, Liuhe Kick, and Iron Sand Palm, had all been cultivated to the limit of Dacheng. He was only one step away from the perfection level.
As for the two third-rate martial arts, Iron Armor Technique and Thunder Step have also progressed very quickly, and are only one step away from becoming great.
